SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JOIN_CODE_ATTEMPT A JOIN GYE_GROUP G ON G.GROUP_ID = A.GROUP_ID WHERE A.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND A.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND A.VERIFIED_YN = 'Y' AND A.CODE_VERSION = G.JOIN_CODE_VERSION AND G.VISIBILITY = 'PRIVATE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JOIN_REQUEST ( JOIN_REQUEST_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, VIA, CODE_VERIFIED_YN, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{joinRequestId}, #{groupId}, #{memberId}, #{via}, #{codeVerifiedYn}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID, OWNER_ID FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId}

SELECT JR.JOIN_REQUEST_ID AS "joinRequestId", JR.GROUP_ID AS "groupId", JR.MEMBER_ID AS "memberId", M.NAME AS "memberName", JR.VIA AS "via", JR.STATUS AS "status", JR.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" FROM JOIN_REQUEST JR LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = JR.MEMBER_ID WHERE JR.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND JR.STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY JR.CREATED_AT ASC, JR.JOIN_REQUEST_ID ASC
